# **🦷 DentalBoutique**

# **Company Services Catalogue & Clinical Service Standards**

**Version 1.0 – Patient-Facing \+ Operational Overview**

This document outlines all core services offered at **DentalBoutique**, including clinical scope, pricing ranges, duration, materials used, and operational benchmarks.

---

# **1️⃣ General & Preventive Dentistry**

## **1.1 Comprehensive Oral Exam**

**![https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-3/PechuBQO7nq4tNJrU765831GXj7Bat9e5v5mV4dzCGUyAq82nWDHfCjyNBTqZgJx1V0Le5pyR1WjrL39NT7dR1uq9vV2pZKCoc77i9b7HCM?purpose=fullsize\&v=1][image1]**

4

**Purpose:** Full diagnostic evaluation of teeth, gums, and oral structures

* Duration: 45–60 minutes  
* Includes: Oral exam, gum assessment, occlusion review, oral cancer screening  
* X-rays: 2–4 bitewings (if needed)  
* Price Range: $120–$250  
* Recommended Frequency: Every 6–12 months

**Operational KPI:**

* Diagnosis documentation rate: 100%  
* Treatment plan presentation rate: ≥ 95%

---

## **1.2 Professional Dental Cleaning (Prophylaxis)**

**![https://www.news-medical.net/image-handler/picture/2018/6/shutterstock\_196219703.jpg][image2]**  
4

* Duration: 45–60 minutes  
* Includes scaling, polishing, fluoride (optional)  
* Price Range: $150–$300  
* Frequency: Every 6 months

**Hygiene Rebooking Target:** ≥ 85%

---

## **1.3 Deep Cleaning (Scaling & Root Planing)**

* Duration: 60–90 minutes per quadrant  
* Typically 2 appointments  
* Price Range: $250–$400 per quadrant  
* Local anesthesia required

**Clinical Benchmark:**

* Post-treatment pocket reduction ≥ 1–2mm improvement

---

# **2️⃣ Restorative Dentistry**

---

## **2.1 Composite Fillings**

**![https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5aea72796e8998ad94228604/5ba3da5380dab51487d12317\_Curing%20Light.jpg][image3]**  
4

**Used for:** Cavities and minor tooth damage

* Duration: 30–60 minutes  
* Material: Tooth-colored composite resin  
* Price Range: $180–$450 (depending on surface count)  
* Longevity: 5–10 years

**Remake Rate Target:** \< 3%

---

## **2.2 Dental Crowns**

**![https://media.healthdirect.org.au/images/inline/original/dental-crown-procedure-illustration-c33196.jpg][image4]**  
4

* Duration: 90 minutes prep \+ 20 min placement  
* Material: Zirconia or porcelain  
* Price Range: $1,200–$1,800  
* Lab turnaround: 7–10 days

**Warranty:** 2 years (under normal use)

---

## **2.3 Dental Bridges**

* Duration: 90 minutes prep  
* Price Range: $2,500–$4,500  
* Lifespan: 10–15 years

---

**![https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-3/qi-8xshIhSaLCXlpja9HC3p2W5JRbiws5FCuuD2G9TQzx4K6rSPg9dG-dQfVBYBztAE4W6e4hiG6Z8XO3H\_Py-Z0SFfSatKzajHkIqmimx4?purpose=fullsize\&v=1][image5]**
